headline: Sales and operating profit grow but net income drops
summary_short: Revenue was KRW 1,426.1B (+13.7% y/y) and operating profit KRW 260.8B (+7.3% y/y); EPS was KRW 1,592, down 35.2% y/y.
summary_long: EPS of KRW 1,592 fell 37.4% q/q and 35.2% y/y. Reports of the company release put revenue at KRW 1,426.1B and operating profit at KRW 260.8B, up 3.0% q/q. Overseas subsidiaries grew 26.2% to KRW 591.8B, domestic 2.0%. Net income fell 36.6% y/y to KRW 111.5B. Guidance is not assessed.
confidence_notes: primary filing unreachable — KPI-only summary — no filing was read; drivers and guidance not assessed. Figures come from wire reposts of the company release and Korean news; one RTTNews item with different numbers was disregarded as undated. EPS is Yahoo data.
